notes.title: Radiology Report
notes.author: Radiologist
notes.text:
Radiology Report
Date: 09/12/2026
Patient: Eladia Walker, 68 y/o F

Exam: MRI lumbar spine

Findings: MRI 09/12/2026: L2 compression fx, marrow edema on STIR. No other acute fractures identified. No paraspinal soft tissue mass or abnormal enhancement. Intervertebral discs show mild degenerative changes without significant herniation or canal stenosis. Neural foramina patent bilaterally.

Impression: L2 compression fracture with marrow edema consistent with acute/subacute injury. No additional acute osseous abnormalities.

Spine Intervention Consult - 09/25/2026

Hx: Referred for DEXA + osteoporosis program.
Exam: Pain at fx level; afebrile, no infx signs.

Imaging reviewed: Vertebral compression fracture noted at T12.
Plan: Proceed with vertebroplasty after confirming bone density results. Monitor for any new neuro deficits.

No contraindications to intervention identified. Will coordinate with osteoporosis program for comprehensive management.

IR consult complete.
